pages.text: Cables are conductive wires used to transfer energy between machines. Different materials have different conductivity and capacity:$(br)• Bronze Cable (Basic)$(br)• Copper Cable$(br)• Gold Cable$(br)• Iron Cable$(br)• Nickel Cable$(br)• Silver Cable$(br)• Steel Cable$(br)• Tin Cable$(br)• Prismite Cable$(br)• Quantum Cable (Advanced)

pages.title: Bronze Cable
pages.text: Basic cable for low voltage energy transfer.

pages.title: Copper Cable
pages.text: Standard cable for moderate energy transfer.

pages.title: Gold Cable
pages.text: High conductivity cable for efficient energy transfer.

pages.title: Silver Cable
pages.text: Highly conductive cable with magical properties.

pages.title: Steel Cable
pages.text: Very durable cable for heavy-duty applications.

pages.title: Tin Cable
pages.text: Basic low-cost cable for simple setups.

pages.title: Prismite Cable
pages.text: Advanced cable with unique refractive properties.

pages.title: Quantum Cable
pages.text: End-game cable with quantum energy transfer capabilities.
